messages:
leah: Tiny idea  rooftop darts + fantasy roster swap tomorrow after work? Loser brings celebratory snacks. :dart: :chip:

omar: Wait fantasy roster swap? Explain.

leah: Quick format: 6-player rooftop darts tourney (win = bragging rights). Parallel: a 1-player fantasy roster blind-swap draw. Everyone submits one player to swap out; draw decides who you get. $5 pool for the swap winner.

dev: Love chaotic swaps. Do we randomize swap pairs or do a blind raffle?

leah: Blind raffle. You drop one name in the hat, draw one from the pool. If you draw your own name, re-draw once.

sam: Darts rules? I can't aim for the life of me.

leah: 301 double-out, single elimination, best-of-3 legs. No headshots on office plants. :grimacing:

omar: GIF-forfeit for the darts loser? Loser posts a smug victory GIF for 2 weeks, SFW.

leah: Yes. Also loser cooks a breakfast bagel run for the team next Monday.

dev: Can we add a tiny tiebreaker for the fantasy swap pot? Closest predicted combined points of swapped players that week wins tie.

omar: Works. Also please confirm buy-in is $5 cash or Venmo @leah.

bot-scheduler: Event created: "Rooftop Darts + Fantasy Swap" 2026-05-08 18:00 PT. Reminder 1h before. Invited: leah, omar, dev, sam.

sam: I'll bring a travel dartboard and some non-alcoholic beers. Who's keeping score?

leah: I'll run the spreadsheet. Quick schema: name, venmo_txn, dart_wins, swap_in, swap_out, notes. Link later.

dev: Small fairness rule: swapped player must be active on a roster by kickoff of next fantasy week to count. If suspended/injured day-of, swap yields 0 points.

omar: Also, if someone flakes, their buy-in goes to the snack fund and they forfeit swaps.

leah: Agreed. Final checklist: $5 buy-in, spreadsheet up, event on calendar, darts rules noted, GIF-forfeit + bagels. Anything else?

sam: Can we get a tiny paper crown for the darts champ? I will wear it proudly.

leah: Crown approved. See you all tomorrow, and may the dumbest dart-thrower win. :trophy:
